slides.title: A strong team gives each other feedback.
slides.headline: A strong team gives each other feedback.
notes: This is the cohesive exercise for the day.
Feedback between peers is a key part of a high-performing team. Leaders need practice to give it well.
Appreciation is the easy first step. It is easy to say on a sports field and harder to say in business.

slides.title: What do you appreciate about the person beside you?
slides.headline: What do you appreciate about the person beside you?
slides.support: A strong team gives each other feedback. It starts with appreciation.
body: Say it to them, then hand them the note.
Go left first, starting with the CEO. Then go right.
notes: This is the cohesive exercise for the day.
Feedback between peers is a key part of a high-performing team. Leaders need practice to give it well. Appreciation is the easy first step.
Everyone writes before anyone speaks. Each person looks at their neighbour while they say it.
The note is theirs to keep.
Suggest the leadership team repeats this monthly, and that leaders take it to their own teams.
